s1.syndrome_frame: Abdominal distention and pelvic mass with complex cystic structure
salient_findings: Multiloculated complex pelvic mass with thick septations on ultrasound
key_facts: 47-year-old perimenopausal woman
3 weeks of worsening abdominal distention
Diffuse abdominal tenderness
Constipation
History of hypothyroidism
History of latent tuberculosis
Prior cesarean section with bilateral tubal ligation
No family history of malignancy
Normal vital signs
Abdomen was distended and diffusely tender on examination
Pelvic examination revealed a 30cm left adnexal mass
Uterus was small and difficult to palpate
Transvaginal and transabdominal ultrasound showed a multiloculated complex pelvic mass
Moderate pelvic free fluid on ultrasound
Uterus was anteverted with a thin endometrial lining
Right ovary measured 3.9 × 3.3 × 3.5cm with a 3cm simple cyst
Contrast-enhanced CT showed a predominantly cystic mass extending from the pelvis to the upper abdomen
Serum CA-125 was elevated at 95 U/mL
